items.heading: Wiener Schnitzel
details: Key ingredients: veal cutlets, flour, egg, breadcrumbs, butter
Pound veal cutlets thin and season lightly.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in butter until golden and crisp on both sides.
Serve immediately with a lemon wedge and potato salad.

items.heading: Sachertorte
details: Key ingredients: chocolate, butter, sugar, eggs, apricot jam
Beat butter, sugar and melted chocolate into a smooth batter with egg yolks.
Fold in whisked egg whites and flour, then bake the cake layers.
Split the cooled cake and spread a thin layer of apricot jam between layers and on top.
Coat the whole cake in a glossy chocolate glaze and let set.
